findings.title: shorten() returns the full text when keep_tokens is 0
findings.why: When tool_result_tokens is 1, result_tokens // 2 is 0. chars becomes 0, the loop is skipped, and text[-0:] returns the entire text, so the result is not shortened (and the note wrongly says the middle was left out). This can still overflow the window.

findings.title: Failed and refused tool calls bypass Conversation.answer
findings.why: The unknown-tool and exception branches append a ToolMessage directly and return. They are therefore neither shortened nor counted by _calls, so a repeated failing call never gets the third-call reminder, and a large exception string can still overflow the window.

findings.title: Window fitting ignores the bound tool schemas
findings.why: room subtracts only the reply reserve, and conversation_tokens counts only messages. The tool definitions passed to bind_tools are part of the model request but are not counted, so the fitted conversation can still exceed the context window by the schema size.

findings.title: fit() stops while still over the window if all results are already shortened
findings.why: The loop only shortens each result once to shortened_tokens and then exits when the loop ends. If the conversation is still larger than room (e.g., many old results at the 500-token head/tail limit, or a baseline prompt that is too large), no further action is taken and the next model call can overflow.
